newsitem.title: UK: Livshits says Russia Duma budget deal may be on.
newsitem.headline: Livshits says Russia Duma budget deal may be on.

text.p: Russian Finance Minister Alexander Livshits believes the Russian Duma or parliament may agree to a budget for 1997 by the end of this year.
"There is still a possibility that the budget for 1997 will be approved this year," Livshits told a press conference in London.
Livshits was in London to speak to investors ahead of a eurobond issue by Russia.
Representatives of the Duma, the Federation Council upper house of parliament and the government agreed a draft budget by a razor thin margin in a reconciliation commission on Wednesday.

But deputies said this did not mean the budget would be approved when the Duma, dominated by the communist opposition, begins debating it on November 22. -- David Chance London newsroom 44 171 542 5887
